items.narration:

items.narration:
The crisp air of the ridge hideout suddenly feels heavier as you plant the damning proof before Handler Veska. Her normally impassive features tighten almost imperceptibly under your scrutiny, acknowledging the weight of the documents. She doesn't immediately deny or accept the charge; instead, she absorbs the evidence with a practiced intensity, ready to counter your accusation.
Action: Confrontation/Presentation
NPC: (Handler Veska) 'So, you bring the evidence to my doorstep,' she says, her gaze sharp as it sweeps over your hands. 'The paperwork linking me to the undue pressure on the Sable Chain is quite damning. What do you intend to do with this knowledge?'

npc.line: That is something we can act on. Tell me exactly where it points next.
npc.speaker: Handler Veska
